title: Nell and the Wig
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 2 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds zz, qu, ch
note_for_grown_ups: The new sounds here are j, v, w, x, y, z, zz and qu. Note that qu is two letters making a /kw/ sound (as in quiz), and x makes a /ks/ sound at the end of six.

pages.illustration: Nell hovering in the centre of the page with her wings drawn as a soft blur, sunflower yellow against clean pale sky. Show speed with the blur, not lines.
Nell wearing a ridiculous curly red wig several sizes too big, which has slipped over one eye. She thinks she looks magnificent.
Close on the wig itself, bright pillar-box red and lovingly detailed with curls, on a twig like a hat on a stand. Nell inspecting it.

pages.text: Zip, zap! Nell can zip up.
pages.illustration: Nell zipping across the page in a zig-zag with the wig streaming behind her, only just hanging on. Sharp angular movement.
Nell perched on a sticky jam bun almost as big as she is, front legs deep in the jam. Rich reds and golden pastry.
Pip on a branch with six plump purple figs lined up in front of him, counting them with one wing. Exactly six — draw them countably.

pages.text: Nell did well in a quiz.
pages.illustration: Nell holding up a small paper quiz card with a big tick on it, front legs in the air in triumph, wig askew.

pages.text: Yes! Nell and Pip had fun.
pages.illustration: Closing page: Nell and Pip on the branch together, the wig now on Pip, jam everywhere, both helpless with laughter.
